# git-github-mcp
> Hardened FastMCP 3.4+ substrate for Git/GitHub operations. 101+ operations (43 git + 58 github) via portmanteau pattern. Fleet ops toolkit, breakfast runner, agentic workflows via LLM sampling. v0.5.0.

Generated on: 2026-07-03

## Tools (11 registered)

| Tool | Ops | Description |
|------|-----|-------------|
| git_core | 11 | Core Git: status, log, diff, init, clone, add, commit, push, pull, fetch |
| git_branch | 14 | Branch lifecycle, merge, rebase, stash, tag |
| git_admin | 16 | Remote, reset, revert, cherry-pick, clean, submodule, bisect, worktree |
| git_blame | 1 | File blame annotation |
| github_ops | 58 | GitHub via gh CLI: repos, issues, PRs, releases, Actions, labels, secrets, collaborators, search, Projects, Packages, Gitingest |
| git_agentic_workflow | - | Multi-step Git/GitHub workflow via LLM sampling (ctx.sample) |
| git_github_search_workflow | - | Agentic GitHub discovery/search via LLM sampling |
| fleet_morning_digest | - | Daily fleet PR/issue/notification breakfast summary |
| fleet_ops | 16 | Fleet maintainer: registry_load, port_audit, ci_pulse, full_suite, etc. |
| git_github_status | - | System status: git/gh availability, versions, auth |
| git_github_help | - | Contextual help at basic/intermediate/advanced levels |

## Resources (8)
- `git://repo/status` — Live git status (cwd)
- `git://repo/log` — Recent commits (last 20)
- `git://{repo_path}/status` — Status for specific repo
- `git://{repo_path}/log` — Log for specific repo
- `github://{owner}/{repo}/issues` — Open issues
- `github://{owner}/{repo}/prs` — Open pull requests
- `git://skills/concepts` — Concept index for tutoring
- `git://skills/{topic}` — Focused lecture notes (rebase, cherry-pick, gitingest, etc.)

## Prompts (7)
- `git_commit_message` — Generate conventional commit message from diff
- `git_release_notes` — Generate release notes from commit history
- `git_pr_description` — Generate PR description
- `git_review_diff` — Code review prompt for a diff
- `github_issue_template` — Generate structured issue body
- `github_debug_workflow` — Debug failing GitHub Actions
- `git_github_explain_concept` — Teaching prompt for Git/GitHub concepts

## Fleet Operations
- **Breakfast runner**: Daily scan of fleet repos — open PRs, issues, stale threads, notifications
- **Full suite**: Morning digest + CI pulse + Dependabot + registry audit + workspace scan + release drift + grade snapshot
- **Delivery**: file (markdown), aiwatcher (POST /api/fleet/ingest), robofang (bridge pulse)
- **Web UI**: `/breakfast` page with tabs for CI, security, registry, workspace, grades, retro

## REST API Endpoints
- `GET /health` — Basic health check
- `GET /api/v1/health` — Full health with uptime, tool count, providers
- `GET /api/v1/diagnostics` — CUA-NSIS smoke test diagnostics
- `GET /api/capabilities` — Auto-discovered tools, prompts, resources, LLM
- `GET /api/status` — git/gh availability and auth
- `GET /api/tools` — Tool list with operation counts
- `GET /api/apps` — Fleet apps hub (registry-based)
- `POST /api/git` — git_ops via REST
- `POST /api/github` — github_ops via REST
- `POST /api/morning-digest` — Breakfast runner via REST
- `POST /api/fleet-ops` — Single fleet operation via REST
- `POST /api/fleet-suite` — Full fleet suite
- `POST /api/fleet-suite/stream` — Streaming NDJSON full suite
- `GET /api/fleet-suite/last` — Last full suite result
- `POST /api/discovery` — Preset GitHub discovery chains
- `GET /api/logs` — Activity log query, stats, export

## Tech Stack
- **Backend**: Python 3.12+, FastMCP 3.4.2+, FastAPI, uvicorn, prefab-ui>=0.14.0
- **Frontend**: React 19, Vite 7, Tailwind 3, React Router 7, Lucide React
- **Native**: Tauri 2.0, NSIS installer (native/)
- **Ports**: Backend 10702, Frontend 10703
- **Transport**: Dual — stdio (Claude Desktop) + HTTP (webapp/Tauri)

## Installation
```powershell
git clone https://github.com/sandraschi/git-github-mcp
cd git-github-mcp
uv sync
npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix web run build
.\start.bat
```

## Requirements
- Python 3.12+
- Git (https://git-scm.com)
- gh CLI (https://cli.github.com) — must be authenticated

## Environment Variables
- `GH_TOKEN` — GitHub Personal Access Token (optional, gh uses its own auth otherwise)
- `WEB_PORT` / `WEB_HOST` — Backend listen address (default 10702 / 127.0.0.1)
- `MCP_TRANSPORT` — `stdio` (default) or `http`
- `MCP_BRIDGE_URLS` — Comma-separated proxy URLs for other MCP servers
- `GIT_GITHUB_FLEET_REPOS_FILE` — Fleet repo list for breakfast runner
- `GIT_GITHUB_DIGEST_DELIVER` — Delivery targets: file, aiwatcher, robofang
- `GIT_GITHUB_WEB_USER` / `GIT_GITHUB_WEB_PASS` — Optional web auth
